n: Edge Impulse free courses on Coursera (Introduction to Embedded ML and Computer Vision with Embedded ML)
t: Coursera courses from Edge Impulse on embedded machine learning and computer vision.
steps: Find the Edge Impulse courses on Coursera.
Check what the free option includes and what needs payment.
Ask IT to review the privacy terms of Coursera and Edge Impulse.
Enroll in Introduction to Embedded Machine Learning first.
Prepare an OpenMV H7 or a Raspberry Pi 4 for the vision labs.
Create an Edge Impulse account for the labs.
